reason: I would download the free version and probably use the receipt scans, since I do bin vegetables every week. But paying for Plus when the free tier already covers expiry reminders, the shared list and recipes? Not at my income.
objection: Another subscription. The free tier already gives me the main thing, and 5 scans a month is about what I'd use anyway, so I don't see why I'd pay $25 a year.
would_change_my_mind: If the receipt scan proved accurate on my local supermarket receipts for a few weeks and the free scan limit was too low, I might pay a one-off or a cheap yearly price.
